citation: For their services alongside the Thirty-third Avalon Hussars Regimental combat Team, under Major-General Wilfred Mandella, in the Capellan theatre during [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOpRAT],Operation RAT]], House Davion presents {COMPANY.CompanyName} the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Davion_LimpSwordFlag],Limp Sword Flag]]. {COMPANY.CompanyName} served admirably in the Battles of Liao, Genoa, Arboris and Woodstock.
